title: Inter Miami and D.C. United Face Off in the 28th MLS Round
seoTitle: Inter Miami vs D.C. United – 28th MLS Round Preview
subtitle: Teams clash at Comunale Stadium in a match marked by a push for table recovery.
excerpt: Inter Miami and D.C. United meet in the 28th MLS round at Comunale Stadium. Get the teams' form and recent history.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The showdown between Inter Miami and D.C. United takes center stage ahead of the match scheduled for Saturday, October 10, 2026, at 8:30 p.m. at Comunale Stadium, part of the 28th round of Major League Soccer. The home side is looking to get back on the winning track after a recent stumble, while the visitors need to pick up points on the road to bounce back in the competition. The fixture pits two teams in very different positions in the league’s regular season.

Inter Miami’s Current Form and Stats

Coached by Cristian "Kily" González, Inter Miami has recorded one win, three draws and one loss in its last five matches. The most recent setback came against Columbus Crew, a 2‑1 defeat. In the domestic league, the team posted back‑to‑back 2‑2 draws against San Diego FC and Nashville SC, while its sole win of the period was a 2‑0 victory over Cruz Azul in a Champions Cup match.

In the standings, Miami sits on 46 points, with a record of 12 wins, 10 draws and 5 losses this season. The attack has netted 64 goals, while the defense has conceded 50. At home, the club’s record reads four wins, seven draws and two defeats.

D.C. United’s Season Snapshot

D.C. United, under head coach René Weiler, has amassed one win, two draws and two losses in its five most recent outings. The team drew 3‑3 with Vancouver Whitecaps and fell 2‑1 to Charlotte FC in league play, while also recording a win over Columbus Crew and a 1‑0 loss in a friendly against SC Paderborn 07.

The club sits on 30 points in the league, with six wins, 12 draws and eight defeats overall. Its offense has scored 34 times, and the defense has allowed 42 goals. On the road, United’s record stands at two wins, seven draws and three losses.

Line‑ups and Unavailable Players

So far, both managers have not confirmed their starting line‑ups for Saturday’s clash. Cristian González and René Weiler have yet to announce their probable squads, as well as the list of players sidelined by injury or suspension, with updates expected in the hours leading up to kickoff.

Recent Head‑to‑Head Advantage

Recent head‑to‑head meetings favor Inter Miami. The most recent encounter between the two sides took place in March 2026, when Miami won away 2‑1. In August 2025, the clubs drew 1‑1 at D.C. United’s home ground.

Betting Odds and Picks

In sports betting markets, Inter Miami is listed as the favorite. On the Hiperbet platform, the odds for a home win are 1.40, while the both‑teams‑to‑score market offers 1.46 at BetMGM and 2.65 at Hiperbet. A draw is priced at 5.84 on the KTO sportsbook.
